style: Premium São Paulo fashion-boutique Instagram editorial model reference photo, like a top influencer clothing brand campaign. Photorealistic, shot on a full-frame camera with an 85mm lens at eye level. One adult woman, an original fictional person (not a celebrity, not any real or recognizable person). Full body from head to toe, the woman fills about 92% of the image height, standing facing the camera in a relaxed confident model pose (weight on one leg, one hand lightly on the hip), whole body and both feet visible, centered. Her face is clearly visible, sharp and well lit: glamorous polished makeup (glowing bronzed skin, softly defined eyes and brows, nude glossy lips), small gold stud earrings, healthy glossy styled hair, a confident soft expression. She wears a simple fitted plain black sleeveless bodysuit with high-waisted straight black trousers and simple nude pointed heels, no bag, no logos, so her body shape is easy to see. Seamless warm ivory-beige studio backdrop that fills the whole frame, no studio lights or equipment visible, soft large-window daylight from the side with gentle real shadows and a soft floor shadow, warm refined color grading. Sharp focus, true-to-life skin texture, natural proportions. No text, no watermark, no logo.
